subError.name: Name is required
subError.paymentCurrency: Payment currency must match the plan currency
subError.refundAmount: Enter a positive refund amount and a valid currency
subError.refundDate: Set a leave date; the refund date cannot precede joining
subError.funding: Invalid split payment: use at least two different payment methods with non-zero amounts, and no single payment method on the same charge
subError.fundingSum: The split amounts must add up to the payment amount
subError.transfer: Invalid transfer: type, date, a positive amount and currency are required
subError.meter: Invalid meter: each needs a unique id and a name
subError.reading: Invalid meter record: each needs a unique id, a valid date and numeric values
subError.meterLink: The linked meter does not exist or is itself linked
subError.meterLinkUsed: “{meter}” is linked by “{name}”; remove that link first
subError.readingMeter: A meter record refers to a meter that is not defined

phase.switchTooEarly: The effective date must be after the current phase starts
phase.resumeNeedsStopDate: Enter the actual stop date and save before resuming
phase.resumeTooEarly: The resume date can't be earlier than the last end date
phase.prependTooLate: The earlier phase must start before the subscription's start date
phase.prependUntil: The earlier phase must end after it starts and before the original start date
phase.priceOutOfRange: The price change date isn't within any phase
phase.keepTooEarly: The keep-until date must be after the switch date
phase.endTooEarly: The end date must be after this phase's start date
phase.endOnNextStart: The end date is the last day of service and can't be the next phase's start date; leave it empty or use the day before to continue into the next phase
phase.startOrder: Phase starts must stay strictly between the adjacent phase starts.
phase.priceDuplicate: A price point already exists on this date
phase.priceInitial: The initial price cannot be deleted
phase.upgradeUnavailable: This switch can’t credit the old plan: it must already be in effect, use the same currency and prepaid billing, and the old plan must have unused days left. Keeping the billing date also needs the same cycle.

yearly.body: About {sum} in total. Annual charges are hard to refund, so now is the time to decide what stays.

body.one: This subscription costs about {sum} a month. Check whether you still need it.
body.other: These {count} subscriptions cost about {sum} a month together. Check whether you still need all of them.

title.one: {count} subscription raised its price in the past year
title.other: {count} subscriptions raised their prices in the past year

intro.body: After that, the price goes from {from} back to {to}.

balance.title: {name} won't last until {date}
balance.body: {sub} needs {need}, with only {current} left by then.
balance.bodyOver: {sub} needs {need}, and the balance is already {current}.

fx.title: {pct}% of spending is in foreign currencies
fx.body: The largest is {ccy} ({share}%). This part gets cheaper when {ccy} weakens, and pricier when it strengthens.

noMethod.body: Add one so balance forecasts and per-method stats are complete.

top.title: {name} is your most expensive subscription
top.body: About {perDay} a day, {pct}% of monthly spending.

stop.title: Stop service
stop.currencyHint: Refunds use {currency}, the subscription currency. Record a different card currency below.
stop.fxMissing: Some loss amounts cannot be converted because exchange rates are missing. Original amounts are shown below.
stop.chargeOnEnd: This day is still a renewal charge. Pick the day before to avoid it.
stop.nonrenewDone: Set to not renew. No charges after {date}.
stop.latestRefundHint: These fields edit the latest refund. Earlier refunds stay in payment history.

renewal.title: Renewal rules
renewal.hint: Domains often renew days before they expire; Apple subscriptions must be cancelled before the charge. Only the charge date and cancel deadline change; the service period stays the same.
renewal.invalid: Enter whole numbers from 0 to 3660 days.
renewal.tooLate: The cancellation deadline has passed. The next period will still be charged.
renewal.cancelReminder: Cancel by {date} to avoid the next charge.
